def orange_pos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def player_pos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
